messages:
Maia Brooks: Quick pass on a slim catalog row prototype — added tiny sparkline for perf trend, inline p95 badge, and a compact pin affordance. Mock: https://figma.com/file/slim-compare
Priya Nair: Sparkline is cool but check contrast; thin lines can vanish in light mode. Also ensure focusable for keyboard users.
Alex Rivera: The inline pin icon needs clearer state. Right now the filled vs outline is subtle. Suggest label on hover and use aria-pressed.
Liam O'Connor: UX tradeoff: sparklines show trend but may clutter when many rows. Maybe hide sparklines below a width breakpoint and surface via hover.
Maia Brooks: Plan: breakpoint hide, sparkline aria-hidden when hidden, tab stops: name -> sparkline (if visible) -> pin -> actions. Space toggles pin when pin has focus.
DesignBot: Accessibility check: sparkline stroke #B3C7FF fails contrast on white at 1px. Recommend 2px or darker #6E8AF6. Add aria-labels: "Performance trend for {model}".
Priya Nair: For pin microcopy: use "Pin version for compare" in tooltip and use toast: "Pinned {model} v{n} — undo".
Alex Rivera: Also tie badge semantics: primary = p95 latency; small secondary hover list shows recent p50 and est token-cost.
Maia Brooks: Thanks. I'll update mock & open experiment ticket for compact rows + sparklines.
